name: Raven Ridge Standard Route (Libby Lake Gully-Ridge)
approach: From Twisp, drive WA-20 east a short distance to WA-153, then south/east on WA-153 (about 1.4–9.4 miles depending on where you start measuring) to Libby Creek Road (County Road 1049/1045). Follow Libby Creek Road to Forest Road 43 (turn, ~5.1–5.5 miles), then left onto Forest Road 4340 (~1.2–1.5 miles), right onto Forest Road 4340-700 (~1.5 miles), and left onto Forest Road 4340-750 to the Libby Lake Trailhead (4,400–4,430 ft; roadside parking for roughly 10 vehicles, no toilet or potable water). From the trailhead, follow Libby Creek Trail #415 to Libby Lake, watching for trail damage (root holes) from the 2018 Crescent Mountain Fire between roughly miles 0.8 and 2.5. A dilapidated cabin sits beside the trail at about 7,170 ft, used by some parties as a base camp.
